subject.title: Dashboard: action-form widget — buttons and forms that dispatch the agent

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor a first-party dashboard action-form builtin that can dispatch parameterized prompts, and under what security/storage contract should that live?
rationale: The issue asks for a new agent-dispatching UI surface, not a broken existing contract; automation cannot decide whether this belongs in the bundled dashboard plugin, a plugin SDK/ClawHub path, or after the Wave 1 stack is redesigned and accepted.

options.title: Defer behind dashboard substrate review
options.body: Keep this issue open but require the Wave 1 dashboard substrate, storage model, and prompt-dispatch security contract to be accepted before implementation starts.

options.title: Sponsor as a bundled builtin
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly approve a first-party action-form widget and review it as security-sensitive dashboard/runtime work.

options.title: Move to external plugin path
options.body: If maintainers do not want prompt-dispatching dashboard widgets bundled in OpenClaw, ask for a plugin SDK or ClawHub package direction instead.

recommendation.title: Defer behind dashboard substrate review
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open but require the Wave 1 dashboard substrate, storage model, and prompt-dispatch security contract to be accepted before implementation starts.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current history signal is ownership of the plugin-tab precedent and adjacent product-routing decisions for bundled Control UI plugin surfaces.
